# Feature name

One sentence: what the customer or the external system gets from this.

## How it works

2–4 sentences of mechanism from **this** repository (package + owning class). Not a ticket list.

## Packages and hooks

| Package | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `Vendor_Module` or app name | plugin / observer / hook / checkout component / worker |

## Configuration

Config paths and the sensible default when the value is empty. No secrets.

## Contract (if any)

REST / GraphQL / Admin API / extension attributes / webhooks / columns another system reads.

## Deliberately does not

Things the code **does not** implement, even if a ticket or an old README suggested otherwise.
